evidence: Module-level code sets HKCU Environment windir to hidden PowerShell repair.ps1 in TEMP plus & rem, runs SilentCleanup, waits, deletes windir.
Sets HKCU Software Classes Folder shell open command to the same command, launches sdclt /KickOffElev, deletes the key.
samples.change: Existing two hostile hijack composites are supported.

samples.identity: Tiegan-disguised obfuscated native DLL injector; Warden association reported externally, not independently attributed
evidence: TLS callback at 0x140003f20 invokes 0x140014190 to initialize obfuscated TLS state. Main at 0x140004130 reaches 0x14000a0a5 and the flattened application routine.
CPU-only Unicorn emulation recovered strings and embedded DLL; all APIs were mocked and no host network, process or file API was executed.
Large transformed string is reconstructed into a PE; instruction 0x14000f6d9 writes the PE signature word. Image sections and imports are reconstructed in memory.
Mocked WriteProcessMemory receives that remote process handle and a 0x9c58d-byte buffer. Emulation stops at the remote write; no downstream theft is asserted.

The IsDebuggerPresent call at 0x140018ee3 is CRT exception handling. EDX=30 at 0x14000ec76 is an allocation size. Header walks also inspect the program itself. Large resource is RT_ICON, not a proved payload.
samples.change: Remove two unsupported hostile loader composites and resource/rename suspicion. Detect TLS flattening and PE reconstruction at suspicious severity.

evidence: UPX-like entry 0x469ad0 decompresses an in-memory loader, reads /proc/self/exe, maps and decompresses the original ELF. CPU-only emulation recovered code at 0x401000 and entry 0x401eb0.

Function 0x406316 probes target ports and dispatches propagation routines. Function 0x4036af connects to Docker API port 2375, detects daemon version, POSTs a privileged Alpine container binding / to /mnt/h, then POSTs the returned container ID to /start. Its command downloads payloads and chroots into the host to execute them.

Function 0x405bc9 sends Redis configuration, SET and SAVE requests targeting cron spool directories. At 0x405f04 it formats a recurring wget-and-shell cron value and sends it through the connected descriptor.
Recovered data includes IoT credential tables, SOCKS proxy support and appliance command-injection templates; no family assignment rests on the vendor Hajime label.
samples.change: Consolidate vizxv spellings so one password counts once. Retain the two-password proxy brute-forcer and require downloader evidence for the self-image/proxy bot composite.

matcher_scope_changes: MOV disp8 matcher excludes register operands and SIB forms that lack a +0x3c displacement.
PE signature CMP matcher now requires the indexed memory compare form.
Canonical MOVSXD matcher takes union of prior PE/DLL and size scopes; consumers were updated explicitly.
EDX=30 retains bytes and scope but becomes a baseline instruction observation.
Downloader output-option matcher admits ELF embedded command strings.

TLS flattening directly requires five TLS-read/relative-jump sequences within 256 bytes; independent byte matching recovered five complete sequences. All PE boundary and benign controls were rerun after this tightening.
limitations: The installed atomscan embeds an older Cleave engine: its UPX failure is still emitted as hostile with misleading not-packed wording. Current source-matched Cleave records a notable metadata recovery limitation. It is engine-emitted and cannot be repaired by YAML.
External report URLs were inaccessible; the verdicts above rely on local code and emulation, not report scores.
